arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
transliteration: SubhanAllah
translation: Glory be to Allah

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Alhamdulillah
translation: All praise is due to Allah

arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Allahu Akbar
translation: Allah is the Greatest

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
transliteration: La ilaha illallah
translation: There is no god but Allah

arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
transliteration: Astaghfirullah
translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah
translation: There is no power nor strength except with Allah

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: SubhanAllahil Azeem
translation: Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
translation: There is no god but You, glory be to You, I was among the wrongdoers

arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel
translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad
translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad

arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: Rabbighfir li
translation: My Lord, forgive me

arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ
transliteration: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah
translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni
translation: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
transliteration: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah
translation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner

arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Subhana Rabbiyal Azeem
translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent

arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى
transliteration: Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High

arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma
translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge

arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ
transliteration: Tawakkaltu 'alallah
translation: I place my trust in Allah

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillah
translation: In the name of Allah

arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azeem
translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but Him. In Him I trust, and He is Lord of the Mighty Throne

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Aleem
translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm; He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing

arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّاً
transliteration: Radeetu billahi Rabban, wa bil-Islami deenan, wa bi-Muhammadin nabiyyan
translation: I am content with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad as my Prophet

arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu birahmatika astagheeth, aslih li sha'ni kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn
translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Set right all my affairs and do not leave me to myself for even the blink of an eye

arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer
translation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His the praise, and He is capable of all things

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi
translation: Glory and praise be to Allah, as many as His creation, as pleases Him, as the weight of His Throne, and as endless as His words

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and deeds that are accepted

arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh
translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad
translation: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad

arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Bismika Rabbi wada'tu janbi wa bika arfa'uh, fa'in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-saliheen
translation: In Your name my Lord I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
transliteration: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsi wa Anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wa mahyaha, in ahyaytaha fahfazha, wa in amattaha faghfir laha
translation: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it back. To You belong its death and its life. If You keep it alive, protect it; if You take it, forgive it

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak
translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You raise Your servants

arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana, wa kafana wa awana
translation: All praise is due to Allah, who fed us and gave us drink, sufficed us and sheltered us

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa 'iqabihi, wa sharri 'ibadih
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, and from the evil of His servants

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani fi jasadi, wa radda 'alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bidhikrih
translation: All praise is due to Allah, who restored my health, returned my soul, and allowed me to remember Him

arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
transliteration: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghayruk
translation: How perfect You are, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name, exalted Your majesty, and there is no god but You

arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahummaghfir li
translation: How perfect You are, O Allah our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me

arabic: سُبُّوُحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
transliteration: Subbuhun Quddusun, Rabbul-mala'ikati war-Ruh
translation: Perfect and Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit

arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ
transliteration: Subhana dhil-jabaruti wal-malakuti wal-kibriya'i wal-'azamah
translation: Glory be to the Possessor of might, dominion, majesty and greatness

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْداً كَثيراً طَيِّباً مُبارَكاً فِيهِ
transliteration: Rabbana wa lakal-hamdu, hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh
translation: Our Lord, to You is all praise - abundant, good and blessed

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
transliteration: Allahummaghfir li, warhamni, wahdini, wajburni, wa 'afini, warzuqni, warfa'ni
translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, support me, protect me, provide for me, and raise me

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبادَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You well

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar
translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire

arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
transliteration: Allahu Allahu Rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'a
translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I associate nothing with Him

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummakfini bihalalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak
translation: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful against what is forbidden, and enrich me by Your grace from all besides You

arabic: قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
transliteration: Qadarullahi wa ma sha'a fa'al
translation: It is the decree of Allah, and He does what He wills

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
transliteration: Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabeena, waj'alni minal-mutatahhireen
translation: O Allah, make me among those who turn to You in repentance, and among those who keep themselves pure

arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min kheefatih
translation: Glory be to Him whom the thunder glorifies with praise, and the angels too, in awe of Him
